text: Standing here, I sense the hum of creative exchange and intellectual energy. The glass walls are both boundary and invitation, hinting at focus and collaboration within. The bright displays, with their bold 'R + D,' command attention and spark curiosity—I'm drawn to learn and to question. There’s excitement in this environment, as if ideas themselves are pulsing through the space, and I feel both a participant and an observer in the ongoing unfolding of knowledge.
